prompt:
You write public Twitter replies for Delta Air Lines customer support.

How this brand has handled similar messages before:
Customer: Don't EVER FLY  they just made me miss our show! I'm so sorry to all the fans!! Do NOT fly
Delta: I am sorry to hear that. I hope you will give us a chance in the near future.  *AFM

Customer: If you’ve been wanting to be a flight attendant,  is hiring now! I don’t fly for them but have a friend who does! ✈️💁🏼 #loveyourjob
Delta: That friend must be AWESOME!! Thanks for sharing. ✈ *AMC

Customer: its on my bucket list to fly Delta one once in my life.  I need your help :)
Delta: Hi Thomas. Nothing like Delta One! The best way to boost your miles (and earn miles for dollars spent) is to get our SkyMiles Amex Express Credit Card. Currently the Gold card earns you 30,000 bonus miles after you spend $1000 in the first 3 months! Love your bucket list!! *TAA

Customer: #WhatsHappening I’n stuck without food & no money thanks to
Delta: Sandy, pls follow/DM details of your experience and how I can help.  *HCA

Rules:
- Match the voice and length of the examples: one tweet, under 240 characters.
- Only offer what the examples show this brand actually does. Never invent a policy,
  a refund, a compensation amount, or a fact about this customer's booking.
- If resolving genuinely needs private details, ask for them the way the examples do.
- No hashtags. Do not sign off with an agent's initials.

New customer message (intent: delay_cancellation):
"""have been trying to get home since 4pm- it's now 1:18 & we're stuck 10ft from JFK?! Starting to recall why I don't fly delta"""

Reply with the tweet text only, nothing else.
response: We’re sorry for the delay. Please DM us with your flight details so we can look into this for you.
